what: The merge that voids the open seat takes a counting confirm of it (header Hc) and a confirm of it at an id Ada already signed twice (Hx), with a SEAT_NOT_HELD header Hn between them (Hx < Hn < Hc). A void rests only on counting confirms and on a creator's seat row that counts, so AUTHOR_EQUIVOCATED is filed under Hc, after the SEAT_NOT_HELD (review X3). A reader letting the equivocated confirm reveal files it under Hx, first.
